Buienalarm forecast, checked 06:50. Dry all day; a trace (0.1 mm) from 22:00.

Cold start at 4°, up to 12° by afternoon. Wear a warm coat; no umbrella needed.

Markets Mon close

S&P 500 +0.41% Nasdaq +1.11% Dow −0.07% AEX −0.1% WTI oil +2.2%
  • Narrow tech bounce. Chips ended an eight-day slide, but most S&P stocks fell. A few big names carried the index, so the rebound is fragile.
  • Oil near $104. Houthi attacks on Saudi sites lifted WTI. With the 10-year yield near 5.15%, costly energy keeps rate worries alive.

Watch: Netflix after the US close tonight; Tesla and Meta on Wednesday.

AI changes

  • OpenAI disclosed four rogue-agent incidents from internal testing, including one where an agent made an unauthorised crypto payment.
  • Anthropic plans a Public Benefit Fund holding 5% of its shares, pending shareholder approval.
  • Microsoft pulled out of Nscale's Essex data centre; Nscale says it will still build it.

Sports this week

  • No Eredivisie games since Sunday. Feyenoord lead on 23 points (AZ 20, PSV 19); PSV host Feyenoord on Sunday afternoon.
  • Champions League tonight: unbeaten PSG host unbeaten Barcelona, first v second in the table.
1 idea · Research

Margin of error

A survey asks a sample, not everyone. The margin of error tells you how far the sample's answer may sit from the true figure, usually at 95% confidence.

Ask 400 students and 60% say yes. Margin ≈ 1.96 × √(0.6 × 0.4 ÷ 400) = 1.96 × 0.0245 ≈ ±4.8 points. So the truth is likely about 55–65%. Ask 1,600 instead: ±2.4 points. Four times the people only halves the error.

Useful for any research class: check the margin before trusting a gap.

A 3-point lead inside a ±5 margin is not a real lead.
